note: Values read off the figures of Geist et al., Med 6, 100881 (2025, CC BY 4.0) and of the poster "Shaping a New Era in Nuclear Medicine", each read twice independently and reconciled; Figure 2A is printed (exact). The poster's patients only as group summaries.

fig3.title: BMI healthy <= 24.4 kg/m2
fig3.notes: No heart, no lungs. Muscle's thin blue line ends at adrenal and passes through pancreas (an aim test settled it). fat-intestine is mostly hidden under the red fat-brain line and overlaps brain-intestine below brain, so both w are rough. These lines pass behind another node; each was traced end to end: thyroid-pancreas and muscle-kidneys behind fat, pancreas-kidneys and adrenal-liver behind brain, liver-intestine at the edge of kidneys, adrenal-marrow at the edge of intestine.

fig3.title: BMI healthy > 24.4 kg/m2
fig3.notes: Same layout as A_low. Thyroid is isolated. Brain is the yellow hub (paper: Z = 2.0; with these weights z = 1.99). The thin blue pancreas-spleen line clips the edges of brain and kidneys. brain-kidneys is confirmed: its line passes 0.35 px from where brain's lines meet and 10.6 px from pancreas's.

fig3.title: low tumor load
fig3.notes: No bone marrow, no lungs. fat-muscle is a short thick blue link beside the red fat-brain line. Fat, muscle and adrenal are collinear, so the red muscle-adrenal line could instead be fat-adrenal. R1 ruled out spleen-heart, liver-intestine and an extra fat-adrenal link.

fig3.title: high tumor load
fig3.notes: Same layout as B_low. Thyroid is isolated. Muscle is the yellow hub (the paper's text says 'orange node', Z = 1.8; with these weights z = 1.73). spleen-fat and fat-brain (both red) could be one spleen-brain line. muscle-adrenal could be fat-adrenal (collinear). spleen-muscle passes about 6.5 px from the fat centre.

fig3.title: Lower Tertile: CRP < 0.11 mg/dl
fig3.notes: No brain, no lungs; all three C panels share one layout. A clear panel: all 18 links can be followed end to end. Line ends sit about 4 px above the icon centres here. Fat has the largest strength (z about 2.0 with these weights) but is not coloured as a hub.

fig3.title: Middle Tertile: CRP 0.11 - 0.74 mg/dl
fig3.notes: Heart and adrenal are isolated. Liver, muscle, fat and marrow lie on one line. Red runs from liver through muscle to fat, as one straight line (same slope and saturation on both sides of muscle), read as liver-fat. Blue runs from fat to marrow, and a blue fringe shows along the left edge of the red line between muscle and fat, read as muscle-marrow passing behind fat. Alternatives are in 'uncertain'.

fig3.title: Upper Tertile: CRP 0.74 - 40.1 mg/dl
fig3.notes: Five nodes are isolated. All 6 links are blue. Muscle is the yellow hub. liver-muscle and muscle-fat differ in saturation and width, so they are two links, not one liver-fat line. The scale is uncertain by about 17%, because 3% is a rounded value.

fig4.title: FDG (N = 241)
fig4.notes: Panel A, printed 'FDG (N = 241)' and '9 %'. n is the cohort N from the title; the network has 9 nodes. 11 links: 8 blue, 3 red (intestine-liver, liver-lungs, fat-thyroid). All 9 organs are linked; adrenal only to pancreas. No node is orange or yellow, so no hubs. Both readers found the same links and signs. Line width and colour are scaled to this panel's strongest link (liver-spleen), so w = relative strength x 0.471, the scale that makes the density exactly 9 % (sum |w| = 3.24 for N = 9; 8.5-9.5 % gives 0.444-0.497). Consensus relative strengths: liver-spleen 1.00, fat-pancreas 0.94, fat-muscle 0.60, fat-thyroid -0.60, adrenal-pancreas 0.57, intestine-liver -0.57, liver-lungs -0.56, pancreas-thyroid 0.55, lungs-muscle 0.53, muscle-thyroid 0.49, fat-spleen 0.47. The light-blue fat-spleen line runs behind the lower edge of the adrenal node (20-25 px from its centre), so it is not fat-adrenal or adrenal-spleen. Strength z-scores from these weights: fat 1.54, liver 0.88, pancreas 0.77, adrenal and intestine -1.38; none above 1.7, consistent with no hub colouring. Pixel centres in f-006.png (1768 x 769): intestine 187.5,143; fat 421,177; lungs 36,256; adrenal 263,276; spleen 104,431; liver 291,444; muscle 526,426; pancreas 130,614; thyroid 299,632 (node radius about 30 px).

fig4.title: Hexokinase 2 (N = 946)
fig4.notes: Panel B, GTEx hexokinase 2 expression, printed 'Hexokinase 2 (N = 946)' and '7 %'. 17 links: 14 blue, 3 red (intestine-liver, intestine-thyroid, liver-thyroid). All 9 organs are linked. No hub colouring. Both readers found the same links and signs. The lines look thick only because they are scaled to this panel's own strongest link (intestine-muscle, the only one at full colour). Reading them on an absolute colour scale would give a density of about 36 %, not 7 %. w = relative strength x 0.199, which makes the density exactly 7 % (6.5-7.5 % gives 0.185-0.213), so every HK2 partial correlation is about 0.11-0.20. Consensus relative strengths: intestine-muscle 1.00, liver-spleen 0.88, intestine-lungs 0.88, spleen-thyroid 0.85, fat-liver 0.85, fat-pancreas 0.85, adrenal-pancreas 0.80, adrenal-muscle 0.80, adrenal-liver 0.75, pancreas-thyroid 0.68, intestine-liver -0.65, liver-thyroid -0.65, lungs-thyroid 0.65, adrenal-intestine 0.62, fat-muscle 0.60, muscle-spleen 0.60, intestine-thyroid -0.55. Geometry, as both readers found: the thin blue line right of the liver is spleen-muscle, passing behind the upper part of the liver node about 15 px above its centre (y 426.5 at x = 1000; spleen-muscle predicts 427.5, liver-muscle 435.5), so there is no liver-muscle link. Two red lines leave the intestine: the darker ends at the liver, the paler passes left of the liver to the thyroid; liver-thyroid is a separate red link. Adrenal-intestine and adrenal-liver are two separate blue links. There is no adrenal-thyroid link. Strength z-scores: liver 1.28, intestine 1.19, lungs -1.72; none above 1.7. The layout is identical to A: pixel centres are A's plus 598 px in x.

fig4.title: Cumulated GLUT1 – GLUT4 (N = 946)
fig4.notes: Panel C, GTEx cumulated GLUT1-4 expression, printed 'Cumulated GLUT1 – GLUT4 (N = 946)' and '16 %'. 23 links: 13 blue, 10 red. All 9 organs are linked; muscle only to liver (red). No hub colouring. Both readers found the same links and signs. w = relative strength x 0.613, which makes the density exactly 16 % (15.5-16.5 % gives 0.593-0.632). Consensus relative strengths: spleen-thyroid 1.00, fat-pancreas 0.66, intestine-lungs 0.66, adrenal-thyroid 0.61, fat-intestine 0.57, liver-thyroid 0.53, liver-spleen -0.49, lungs-pancreas 0.44, fat-lungs -0.37, adrenal-lungs 0.34, lungs-spleen -0.34, fat-spleen -0.34, lungs-thyroid 0.34, intestine-pancreas -0.33, liver-muscle -0.33, intestine-spleen 0.32, liver-pancreas -0.32, fat-thyroid 0.29, adrenal-spleen -0.28, adrenal-fat 0.27, intestine-liver -0.22, pancreas-spleen 0.19, adrenal-pancreas -0.16. Hardest part: the vertical blue band from the adrenal through the liver to the thyroid. Above the liver it is one 9 px line, centred at x about 1478 at y = 380, on the adrenal-thyroid path (predicted 1479; adrenal-liver would be 1485). Below the liver, the band's left edge follows the adrenal-thyroid slope (0.10) and its right edge the liver-thyroid slope (0.05). The paler strip at its right is the part of liver-thyroid not covered by adrenal-thyroid, which is drawn on top. So the reading is adrenal-thyroid plus liver-thyroid, with no adrenal-liver link. The faint red line to the muscle is liver-muscle, not spleen-muscle (centre y 444.5 at x = 1600; liver-muscle predicts 445.1, spleen-muscle 436.6). The faintest lines (adrenal-pancreas red, pancreas-spleen lavender, intestine-liver pink) are thin but present at full resolution. Strength z-scores: spleen 1.12, thyroid 0.87, muscle -2.26; none above 1.7. The layout is identical to A, shifted by +1206.5 px in x and +8.5 px in y (the same for every node within 1 px, so not stretched).

heterogeneity.low: Labelled 'low'. Six identical mid-grey discs (#949494, radius about 27 px, no outline) on a regular hexagon with flat top and bottom edges and vertices at left and right: poster centres (4421,4468), (4611,4468), (4708,4632), (4611,4792), (4421,4792), (4324,4632) (side about 190 px). Six equal links (about 7.6 px, #a0a0a0) join them in a ring; every node has degree 2. No highlighted node.
heterogeneity.high: Labelled 'high'. Nine nodes, nine links of very unequal weight. Hub H: a larger orange filled disc (#e88b43, radius about 45 px, about 1.6 x the others' 27-29 px) slightly left of the drawing's centre. From H: two thick near-black links (about 16.5 px, #434343) to the dark nodes A (upper left) and G (lower right), forming one near-straight diagonal through the hub; a thick orange link (about 16 px, #e68239, the highlighted one) to the dark node C on the right, a little above the hub; a medium grey link (about 8.3 px, #959595) to the light node E at the left, below the hub; a thin grey link (about 5 px, #9e9e9e) to the light node F below and slightly left. Around the edge: A to the light node B at the top (about 4 px, #bdbdbd); B to C, medium (about 9.4 px, #8b8b8b); C to the very light node D at far right, lower (about 3.4 px, #c2c2c2); G to the very light node I at the bottom (about 3.3 px, #a6a6a6). Node shade follows the strength of its links: A #727171, C #787878, G #777575 dark; E and F #a6a6a6 mid-light; B #ababab light; D #c1c1c1 and I #bcbbbb very light.

creation.clearance: A hub-and-spoke star under the bold title 'clearance'. Centre: a large white circle with a thick black ring (about 9 px; outer radius about 136 px across, 128 px up and down, so very slightly wider than tall), centre at poster (4850, 3815). Inside it a light grey (#cbcbcb) pair of kidney-bean shapes side by side, mirror images, with a bold black capital 'K' over them (K for kidneys: renal tracer handling, which the poster calls Clearance). Six plain mid-grey filled discs (#afabab, no outline, radius about 52 px, 0.38-0.41 of the centre's) about 253-276 px from the centre (about twice its radius), at about 0 (right), 63 (upper right), 126 (upper left), 180 (left), 243 (lower left) and 312 (lower right) degrees counter-clockwise from +x. Each is joined to the centre by one thin light grey line (about 6-7 px, #afabab-#aaaaaa), all equal. No links between satellites.
